name: autopathcomment
description: Adds a comment with the file's relative path at the top of the file upon saving

autopathcomment.commentSyntaxMap.markdownDescription: Custom mapping of file extensions to single-line comment prefixes. Keys must include the dot (e.g. `.ts`) and values are prefixes like `//` or `#`. User values override built-in defaults.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
scripts.lint: biome check src scripts .vscode .vscode-test.mjs esbuild.js .commitlintrc.cjs package.json tsconfig.json biome.json release-please-config.json --error-on-warnings
scripts.check: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm test
